| Rung | Device | Status |
|------|--------|--------|
| bgp_session | RR1 | healthy — session to 10.255.0.13 **Established** |

| route_to_peer | RR1 | healthy — route to 10.255.0.13/32 present (2 paths) |
| igp_adjacency | PE3 | healthy — 2 IS-IS adjacencies, all Up |
| interface | PE3 | healthy — 2 of 2 members healthy |

Neither limitation changes the outcome: the deterministic descent — the graded, authoritative answer — reports **no fault found** on this dependency path. The `bgp_no_prefixes` (0 prefixes received) observations are noted as the normal state for this lab by the operator and are not a fault.
